# BidEyes

BidEyes is a pre-bid risk review pipeline for commercial electrical subcontractors. 
It uses the Anthropic Claude API to cross-reference MEP specifications, drawings, and addenda.

## Core Features
- Extracts scope gaps and spec conflicts.
- Drafts RFI questions.
- Provides exact page citations for every finding.

## Technical Stack
- Model: Claude 3.5 Sonnet (claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022)
- Architecture: Document ingestion -> Topic Routing -> Claude API Extraction -> JSON validation -> UI
- Security: TLS 1.3, Auth via Clerk, No model training on customer data.
